# Bageo v1.3.0

- **A whitelisted caller with an emergency can bring you into the call** (trial, off by default): the AI asks them to hold, calls you and joins the two calls.
- **The AI no longer says it will put the call through.** It says you will call back.
- **Safer notification links.** One-tap links ask you to confirm first. Links in older notifications, calendar links included, stop working.
- **Numbers from any country work**, and calls in Thai, Russian, Arabic and Hindi end properly after the goodbye.
- **More chat room options:** Slack commands, Discord private messages, Matrix auto-join. Phone and text forwarding fixes need the new phone module.
- **Contributor agreement (CLA) and legal terms**, the same in three languages.

## 繁體中文

- **白名單來電有急事，可以把你接進通話**（試驗功能，預設關閉）：AI 請對方別掛、撥給你，再把兩通電話合在一起。
- **AI 不再說「幫你轉接」**，只說會回電給他。
- **通知連結更安全。** 一鍵連結先請你確認再執行；舊通知裡的連結（包含行事曆連結）會失效。
- **各國的號碼都能用**，泰文、俄文、阿拉伯文、印地文的電話在道別後會正確掛斷。
- **聊天室更多選擇：** Slack 指令、Discord 私訊、Matrix 自動進房。手機與簡訊轉發的修正要更新手機模組。
- **新增貢獻者授權協議（CLA）與法律條款**，三種語言內容一致。

Full changes / 完整變更：[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/h4lo-void/bageo-call/blob/v1.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)
